name: Crontab Buddy
description: A calm companion for crontab syntax. Type a schedule and get a sentence you can actually read, the upcoming run times with how long until each one, and every field expanded so you can see exactly which minutes, hours, days and months are selected. Catches the classic traps, such as the day-of-month and day-of-week fields being combined with OR. Fully offline.

browser_action.default_title: Crontab Buddy — Cron schedules, explained like a human would
